SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category,
    round(
        100.0 * sumIf(os.SalesAmount, rc.CustomerKey IS NOT NULL) / sum(os.SalesAmount),
        2
    ) AS repeat_customer_sales_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS os
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON os.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber) >= 2
) AS rc
    ON os.CustomerKey = rc.CustomerKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY pc.ProductCategoryName;
